scenes.title: 新学期老师
scenes.subtitle: A warm welcome
scenes.story: September brings Teachers’ Day. A young visitor says every teacher must be kind and patient. The students smile and sing a song.
scenes.storyZh: 九月迎来了教师节。一位年轻的来访者说，每位老师都必须友善又有耐心。学生们微笑着唱起歌。

scenes.title: 安静课堂
scenes.subtitle: A quiet reading room
scenes.story: The strict teacher says “shh” when the room becomes noisy. A thin girl was reading quietly, and the class takes pleasure in the story.
scenes.storyZh: 教室变得吵闹时，严格的老师轻声说“嘘”。一个瘦瘦的女孩正在安静阅读，全班都很享受这个故事。

scenes.title: 旧照片
scenes.subtitle: Pictures from the past
scenes.story: Mia sends an e-card and really likes the handsome picture. Her cousin had a grey hat as a teenager, and their photos were on the desk.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅发送了一张电子贺卡，她真的很喜欢那张英俊的照片。她的表亲青少年时有一顶灰帽子，他们的照片放在桌上。

scenes.title: 新同学
scenes.subtitle: Meet the new student
scenes.story: His new student arrives two years ago. She is active and pretty, and her smart answers usually make the class say “wow”.
scenes.storyZh: 他的新学生两年前来到这里。她活泼又漂亮，她聪明的回答通常会让全班说“哇”。

scenes.title: 不同心情
scenes.subtitle: A changeable morning

scenes.title: 丢失的书
scenes.subtitle: Angry and sad
scenes.story: Ben becomes angry after he finds a lost book. He feels sad and wants to shout, but he does not shout at his friend.
scenes.storyZh: 本找到一本遗失的书后生气了。他感到伤心，想大声喊叫，但他没有对朋友大喊。

scenes.title: 小狗来访
scenes.subtitle: A worried friend
scenes.story: A small dog runs into the classroom. Mia is glad to help and not worried about the game.
scenes.storyZh: 一只小狗跑进教室。米娅很高兴能帮忙，也不担心游戏。

scenes.title: 昨日惊喜
scenes.subtitle: Finding the ball
scenes.story: The children play games after class. They do not worry when they cannot find her ball. They saw it yesterday, so everyone is surprised.
scenes.storyZh: 孩子们课后玩游戏。找不到她的球时，他们并不担心。他们昨天看见过球，所以每个人都很惊讶。

scenes.title: 春日月份
scenes.subtitle: Months in bloom
scenes.story: When spring comes, March brings green leaves. May and April add flowers to the park.
scenes.storyZh: 春天到来时，三月带来绿叶。五月和四月为公园增添花朵。

scenes.title: 十月礼物
scenes.subtitle: A present in autumn
scenes.story: The class meets again in October. Mia opens a present and finds a note.
scenes.storyZh: 全班在十月再次相聚。米娅打开礼物，发现了一张便条。

scenes.title: 生日许愿
scenes.subtitle: A wish for Grandma
scenes.story: Before the cake, everyone can make a wish. Mia gives Grandma the last card she made.
scenes.storyZh: 蛋糕端上来之前，每个人都可以许愿。米娅把最后一张自己制作的卡片送给奶奶。

scenes.title: 家庭晚餐
scenes.subtitle: Food, music and family
scenes.story: Mia drew a picture for every parent. The dish smelled good, they ate together, and the children sang while Ben did the dishes.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅为每位家长画了一幅画。菜肴闻起来很香，大家一起吃饭，孩子们唱歌，本负责洗碗。

scenes.title: 来到乡村
scenes.subtitle: A quiet place
scenes.story: A country village is quiet near the river. A small house stands between two trees.
scenes.storyZh: 一个乡村小村庄在河边显得很宁静。一座小房子立在两棵树之间。

scenes.title: 果园篮筐
scenes.subtitle: Collecting fruit
scenes.story: There are lots of apples in the box, and a lot of juice too. The children catch a butterfly and find some interesting leaves, but they do not have any baskets.
scenes.storyZh: 盒子里有许多苹果，也有很多果汁。孩子们抓住一只蝴蝶，发现了一些有趣的叶子，但他们没有篮子。

scenes.title: 采摘时光
scenes.subtitle: In the orchard
scenes.story: The orchard looks like a green sea. They pick a cucumber from the ground and put it in a bag.
scenes.storyZh: 果园看起来像一片绿色的海。他们从地上摘了一根黄瓜，放进袋子里。

scenes.title: 放学以后
scenes.subtitle: A walk by the field
scenes.story: My cousin is a fourth grader. After school, we walk past the field and watch a cow.
scenes.storyZh: 我的表亲是一名四年级学生。放学后，我们走过田地，看着一头奶牛。

scenes.subtitle: First practice

scenes.title: 传球投篮
scenes.subtitle: Practice on the court
scenes.story: Mia holds the ball beside the basket. She will pass it and then shoot.
scenes.storyZh: 米娅在篮筐旁拿着球。她将把球传出去，然后投篮。

scenes.title: 团队约定
scenes.subtitle: Playing together
scenes.story: Our team hopes to win the match. Their coach says they must not stop.
scenes.storyZh: 我们队希望赢得比赛。他们的教练说绝不能停下来。

scenes.title: 最后胜利
scenes.subtitle: The final shot
scenes.story: The final shot was easy. Mia got the ball and shot again; in the end, her team won.
scenes.storyZh: 最后一次投篮并不难。米娅接到球再次投篮，最终她的球队获胜了。

scenes.title: 身边的榜样
scenes.subtitle: A special teacher
scenes.story: A teacher can be a role model. The scientist wrote about a medical worker, and a medical scientist helped a baby who was born in the town. People can be born in many places.
scenes.storyZh: 老师可以成为榜样。科学家写了一位医务工作者的故事，一位医学科学家帮助了出生在小镇上的宝宝。人们可以在许多地方出生。

scenes.title: 古老发现
scenes.subtitle: History and herbs
scenes.story: The herb took time to grow. An amazing old temple from 500 A.D. appears on paper, and 300 B.C. is written beside it. We found the drawing in a book.

scenes.title: 坚持与付出
scenes.subtitle: A map around the lake
scenes.story: She works hard and must work hard every day. We need more practice so we never stop and never give up. The teacher gave us a map of the route round the lake, which is open all year round.
scenes.storyZh: 她努力学习，也必须每天努力。我们需要更多练习，所以从不停止。老师给了我们一张绕湖路线图，那条环湖路线全年开放。

scenes.title: 社区厨房
scenes.subtitle: Success through teamwork
scenes.story: Finally, the team will succeed. We learn a lot together as volunteers. Cooking for every person is easier because we plan together.
scenes.storyZh: 团队最终会成功。我们作为志愿者一起学到了很多。因为大家一起计划，为每个人烹饪变得更轻松。

scenes.title: 春节团圆
scenes.subtitle: A wonderful celebration
scenes.story: A relative returns for Spring Festival. In February and January, the night sky is full of firework colours and wonderful music.
scenes.storyZh: 一位亲戚回来过春节。二月和一月，夜空充满烟花的色彩和美妙的音乐。

scenes.title: 张贴春联
scenes.subtitle: Preparing the front door
scenes.story: Before the big dinner, the family will put up a couplet. Spring Festival couplets shine beside the door on the eve.
scenes.storyZh: 丰盛晚餐前，一家人会张贴一副对联。除夕前夜，春联在门旁闪闪发亮。

scenes.title: 新年祝福
scenes.subtitle: Lucky money and hope
scenes.story: Next year, Mia hopes for lucky days. She saves money and receives lucky money in a red packet.
scenes.storyZh: 明年，米娅期待幸运的日子。她攒钱，也收到红包里的压岁钱。
